fullText.simplified:
第十二章、楚国败了

    在汉北的第三年，我从百姓那里听到了来自引都的消息。
    齐国和另外两个小国，一起攻打楚国。楚怀王为了请秦国帮忙，把楚国的太子送到秦国作人质，然后秦国出兵帮助楚国打败了三国的军队。
    我叹了一口气。这些年里楚国和齐国的关系变来变去，终于还是开战了。太子是下一位楚王，楚王把太子送到秦国，就是把下一个楚王的生死交到秦国手上，以后楚国的路会不好走。
    又过了一年，我听到了更让人吃惊的事。
    被送到秦国的楚国太子，因为一件小事，在街上把一位秦国的大官杀了。秦王很生气，太子怕秦王杀他，一个人跑回了楚国。秦王更生气了，他联系齐国、韩国、魏国，准备和他们一起攻打楚国。
    我急得吃不下饭，睡不着觉，只想马上回引都。就在这时，引都来人了，说我可以回去了。
    “情况怎么样？四国的军队打过来了吗？”我问。
    来人的脸色很复杂，回答我：“已经打完了，楚国败了，我们的大将军也战死了。”
    “什么？”我的心一惊，快要哭了。
    我快马回到引都。王宫里，头发全白的楚怀王见到我，红着眼睛说不出话来。他好像累极了，一点儿力气都没有了。我本来有很多话要说，但见到他这个样子，一句话也说不出来了。
    他看了我一眼，苦笑着说：“屈原，我把太子送去齐国了。”
    “您让太子去齐国做质子了？”我有点儿不敢相信。
    “是的，为了让齐国停止进攻，我把太子送给他们了。”
    我吃惊极了，但很快就明白这是没有办法的事情。先让战争停下来，这是最主要的。太子在齐国做质子，如果楚国做了对齐国不好的事情，齐国就会杀太子。为了太子的安全，楚国以后只能和齐国做盟友了。而楚国与齐国结盟，是秦国最不愿意看到的事情，秦国以后一定会再来进攻楚国。
fullText.traditional:
第十二章、楚國敗了

    在漢北的第三年，我從百姓那裡聽到了來自引都的消息。
    齊國和另外兩個小國，一起攻打楚國。楚懷王為了請秦國幫忙，把楚國的太子送到秦國作人質，然後秦國出兵幫助楚國打敗了三國的軍隊。
    我嘆了一口氣。這些年裡楚國和齊國的關係變來變去，終於還是開戰了。太子是下一位楚王，楚王把太子送到秦國，就是把下一個楚王的生死交到秦國手上，以後楚國的路會不好走。
    又過了一年，我聽到了更讓人吃驚的事。
    被送到秦國的楚國太子，因為一件小事，在街上把一位秦國的大官殺了。秦王很生氣，太子怕秦王殺他，一個人跑回了楚國。秦王更生氣了，他聯繫齊國、韓國、魏國，準備和他們一起攻打楚國。
    我急得吃不下飯，睡不著覺，只想馬上回引都。就在這時，引都來人了，說我可以回去了。
    “情況怎麼樣？四國的軍隊打過來了嗎？”我問。
    來人的臉色很複雜，回答我：“已經打完了，楚國敗了，我們的大將軍也戰死了。”
    “什麼？”我的心一驚，快要哭了。
    我快馬回到引都。王宮裡，頭髮全白的楚懷王見到我，紅著眼睛說不出話來。他好像累極了，一點兒力氣都沒有了。我本來有很多話要說，但見到他這個樣子，一句話也說不出來了。
    他看了我一眼，苦笑著說：“屈原，我把太子送去齊國了。”
    “您讓太子去齊國做質子了？”我有點兒不敢相信。
    “是的，為了讓齊國停止進攻，我把太子送給他們了。”
    我吃驚極了，但很快就明白這是沒有辦法的事情。先讓戰爭停下來，這是最主要的。太子在齊國做質子，如果楚國做了對齊國不好的事情，齊國就會殺太子。為了太子的安全，楚國以後只能和齊國做盟友了。而楚國與齊國結盟，是秦國最不願意看到的事情，秦國以後一定會再來進攻楚國。

sentences.traditional: 我嘆了一口氣。這些年裡楚國和齊國的關係變來變去，終於還是開戰了。

sentences.traditional: 楚王把太子送到秦國，就是把下一個楚王的生死交到秦國手上，

sentences.english: The road ahead for Chu would be difficult.

sentences.simplified: 又过了一年，我听到了更让人吃惊的事。
sentences.traditional: 又過了一年，我聽到了更讓人吃驚的事。
sentences.pinyin: yòu guò le yì nián wǒ tīng dào le gèng ràng rén chī jīng de shì
sentences.english: Another year passed, and I heard even more shocking news.

sentences.simplified: 被送到秦国的楚国太子，因为一件小事，在街上把一位秦国的大官杀了。
sentences.traditional: 被送到秦國的楚國太子，因為一件小事，在街上把一位秦國的大官殺了。
sentences.pinyin: bèi sòng dào qín guó de chǔ guó tài zǐ yīn wèi yí jiàn xiǎo shì zài jiē shang bǎ yí wèi qín guó de dà guān shā le
sentences.english: The crown prince of Chu, who had been sent to Qin, killed a high-ranking official of Qin in the street over a trivial matter.

sentences.traditional: 秦王很生氣，太子怕秦王殺他，一個人跑回了楚國。

sentences.english: The King of Qin was furious. Fearing for his life, the crown prince fled back to Chu alone.

sentences.traditional: 秦王更生氣了，他聯繫齊國、韓國、魏國，準備和他們一起攻打楚國。

sentences.english: The King of Qin grew even angrier and contacted the states of Qi, Han, and Wei, preparing to attack Chu together with them.

sentences.simplified: 我急得吃不下饭，睡不着觉，只想马上回引都。
sentences.traditional: 我急得吃不下飯，睡不著覺，只想馬上回引都。

sentences.english: I was so anxious that I couldn’t eat or sleep. I just wanted to hurry back to Yindu.

sentences.simplified: 就在这时，引都来人了，说我可以回去了。
sentences.traditional: 就在這時，引都來人了，說我可以回去了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài zhè shí yǐn dū lái rén le shuō wǒ kě yǐ huí qù le

sentences.traditional: “情況怎麼樣？四國的軍隊打過來了嗎？”我問。
sentences.pinyin: qíng kuàng zěn me yàng sì guó de jūn duì dǎ guò lái le ma wǒ wèn
sentences.english: “What’s the situation? Have the armies of the four states attacked?” I asked.

sentences.simplified: 来人的脸色很复杂，回答我：
sentences.traditional: 來人的臉色很複雜，回答我：
sentences.pinyin: lái rén de liǎn sè hěn fù zá huí dá wǒ
sentences.english: The messenger’s expression was complicated as he replied, ..

sentences.traditional: “已經打完了，楚國敗了，我們的大將軍也戰死了。”

sentences.english: .. “The battle is already over. Chu was defeated, and our great general has fallen in battle.”

sentences.simplified: “什么？”我的心一惊，快要哭了。
sentences.traditional: “什麼？”我的心一驚，快要哭了。
sentences.pinyin: shén me wǒ de xīn yì jīng kuài yào kū le
sentences.english: “What?” I was shocked, and on the verge of tears.

sentences.simplified: 我快马回到引都。
sentences.traditional: 我快馬回到引都。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kuài mǎ huí dào yǐn dū
sentences.english: I rode back to Yindu as fast as I could.

sentences.simplified: 王宫里，头发全白的楚怀王见到我，红着眼睛说不出话来。
sentences.traditional: 王宮裡，頭髮全白的楚懷王見到我，紅著眼睛說不出話來。
sentences.pinyin: wáng gōng lǐ tóu fa quán bái de chǔ huái wáng jiàn dào wǒ hóng zhe yǎn jing shuō bù chū huà lái
sentences.english: King Huai of Chu met me in the palace, his hair all white and his eyes red. He was completely unable to speak.

sentences.simplified: 他好像累极了，一点儿力气都没有了。
sentences.traditional: 他好像累極了，一點兒力氣都沒有了。
sentences.pinyin: tā hǎo xiàng lèi jí le yì diǎn'r lì qi dōu méi yǒu le
sentences.english: He seemed utterly exhausted, with no strength left.

sentences.simplified: 我本来有很多话要说，但见到他这个样子，一句话也说不出来了。
sentences.traditional: 我本來有很多話要說，但見到他這個樣子，一句話也說不出來了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ běn lái yǒu hěn duō huà yào shuō dàn jiàn dào tā zhè ge yàng zi yí jù huà yě shuō bù chu lai le
sentences.english: I had many things I wanted to say, but seeing him like this, I couldn’t utter a word.

sentences.simplified: 他看了我一眼，苦笑着说：“屈原，我把太子送去齐国了。”
sentences.traditional: 他看了我一眼，苦笑著說：“屈原，我把太子送去齊國了。”
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le wǒ yì yǎn kǔ xiào zhe shuō qū yuán wǒ bǎ tài zǐ sòng qù qí guó le
sentences.english: He glanced at me and said with a bitter smile, “Qu Yuan, I have sent the crown prince to the state of Qi.”

sentences.simplified: “您让太子去齐国做质子了？”我有点儿不敢相信。
sentences.traditional: “您讓太子去齊國做質子了？”我有點兒不敢相信。
sentences.pinyin: nín ràng tài zǐ qù qí guó zuò zhì zǐ le wǒ yǒu diǎn'r bù gǎn xiāng xìn
sentences.english: “You sent the crown prince to Qi as a hostage?” I couldn’t quite believe it.

sentences.simplified: “是的，为了让齐国停止进攻，我把太子送给他们了。”
sentences.traditional: “是的，為了讓齊國停止進攻，我把太子送給他們了。”
sentences.pinyin: shì de wèi le ràng qí guó tíng zhǐ jìn gōng wǒ bǎ tài zǐ sòng gěi tā men le
sentences.english: “Yes, to stop Qi from attacking, I sent the crown prince to them.”

sentences.simplified: 我吃惊极了，但很快就明白这是没有办法的事情。先让战争停下来，这是最主要的。
sentences.traditional: 我吃驚極了，但很快就明白這是沒有辦法的事情。先讓戰爭停下來，這是最主要的。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ chī jīng jí le dàn hěn kuài jiù míng bai zhè shì méi yǒu bàn fǎ de shì qing xiān ràng zhàn zhēng tíng xià lai zhè shì zuì zhǔ yào de
sentences.english: I was extremely shocked, but quickly understood that there was no other choice. Stopping the war was the most important thing.

sentences.simplified: 太子在齐国做质子，如果楚国做了对齐国不好的事情，齐国就会杀太子。
sentences.traditional: 太子在齊國做質子，如果楚國做了對齊國不好的事情，齊國就會殺太子。
sentences.pinyin: tài zǐ zài qí guó zuò zhì zǐ rú guǒ chǔ guó zuò le duì qí guó bù hǎo de shì qing qí guó jiù huì shā tài zǐ
sentences.english: With the crown prince as a hostage in Qi, if Chu did anything unfavorable to Qi, they would kill the crown prince.

sentences.simplified: 为了太子的安全，楚国以后只能和齐国做盟友了。
sentences.traditional: 為了太子的安全，楚國以後只能和齊國做盟友了。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le tài zǐ de ān quán chǔ guó yǐ hòu zhǐ néng hé qí guó zuò méng yǒu le
sentences.english: For the crown prince’s safety, Chu could only ally with Qi in the future.

sentences.simplified: 而楚国与齐国结盟，是秦国最不愿意看到的事情，秦国以后一定会再来进攻楚国。
sentences.traditional: 而楚國與齊國結盟，是秦國最不願意看到的事情，秦國以後一定會再來進攻楚國。
sentences.pinyin: ér chǔ guó yǔ qí guó jié méng shì qín guó zuì bú yuàn yì kàn dào de shì qing qín guó yǐ hòu yí dìng huì zài lái jìn gōng chǔ guó
sentences.english: But an alliance between Chu and Qi was the last thing Qin wanted to see. Qin would surely launch another attack on Chu in the future.

sentence_translations: Chapter 12: Chu Is Defeated
In my third year in Hanbei, I heard news from Yindu through the common people.
Qi and two other small states had attacked Chu together.
To seek help from Qin, King Huai of Chu sent the crown prince of Chu to Qin to serve as a hostage.
Qin then sent its troops to help Chu defeat the armies of the three states.
I sighed. Over the years, the relationship between Chu and Qi changed again and again, and in the end, they still went to war.
The crown prince was the next king of Chu.
By sending the crown prince to the state of Qin, Chu had placed the life and death of its next king in Qin’s hands.
The road ahead for Chu would be difficult.
Another year passed, and I heard even more shocking news.
The crown prince of Chu, who had been sent to Qin, killed a high-ranking official of Qin in the street over a trivial matter.
The King of Qin was furious. Fearing for his life, the crown prince fled back to Chu alone.
The King of Qin grew even angrier and contacted the states of Qi, Han, and Wei, preparing to attack Chu together with them.
I was so anxious that I couldn’t eat or sleep. I just wanted to hurry back to Yindu.
Just then, a messenger arrived from Yindu and said that I could return.
“What’s the situation? Have the armies of the four states attacked?” I asked.
The messenger’s expression was complicated as he replied, ..
.. “The battle is already over. Chu was defeated, and our great general has fallen in battle.”
“What?” I was shocked, and on the verge of tears.
I rode back to Yindu as fast as I could.
King Huai of Chu met me in the palace, his hair all white and his eyes red. He was completely unable to speak.
He seemed utterly exhausted, with no strength left.
I had many things I wanted to say, but seeing him like this, I couldn’t utter a word.
He glanced at me and said with a bitter smile, “Qu Yuan, I have sent the crown prince to the state of Qi.”
“You sent the crown prince to Qi as a hostage?” I couldn’t quite believe it.
“Yes, to stop Qi from attacking, I sent the crown prince to them.”
I was extremely shocked, but quickly understood that there was no other choice. Stopping the war was the most important thing.
With the crown prince as a hostage in Qi, if Chu did anything unfavorable to Qi, they would kill the crown prince.
For the crown prince’s safety, Chu could only ally with Qi in the future.
But an alliance between Chu and Qi was the last thing Qin wanted to see. Qin would surely launch another attack on Chu in the future.
